def nat_eq : Nat → Nat → Bool
| 0, 0 => true
| Nat.succ n, Nat.succ m => nat_eq n m
| _, _ => false

def nat_ble : Nat → Nat → Bool
| 0, _ => true
| Nat.succ _, 0 => false
| Nat.succ n, Nat.succ m => nat_ble n m

def nat_blt (n m : Nat) : Bool := nat_ble (Nat.succ n) m

def usizeMax : Nat := 18446744073709551615
def u64Max : Nat := 18446744073709551615
def u32Max : Nat := 4294967295
def u8Max : Nat := 255

def checkedMul (a b : Nat) : Result Nat :=
  match nat_blt usizeMax (a * b) with
  | true => Result.err Err.Overflow
  | false => Result.ok (a * b)

def checkedMul_success (a b : Nat) (h : nat_blt usizeMax (a * b) = false) : checkedMul a b = Result.ok (a * b) :=
  @Eq.subst Bool (fun x => (match x with | true => Result.err Err.Overflow | false => Result.ok (a * b)) = Result.ok (a * b))
    false (nat_blt usizeMax (a * b)) (Eq.symm h) ⟨⟩

def checkedMul_failure (a b : Nat) (h : nat_blt usizeMax (a * b) = true) : checkedMul a b = Result.err Err.Overflow :=
  @Eq.subst Bool (fun x => (match x with | true => Result.err Err.Overflow | false => Result.ok (a * b)) = Result.err Err.Overflow)
    true (nat_blt usizeMax (a * b)) (Eq.symm h) ⟨⟩

def checkedAddU64 (a b : Nat) : Result Nat :=
  match nat_blt u64Max (a + b) with
  | true => Result.err Err.Overflow

def checkedAddU64_success (a b : Nat) (h : nat_blt u64Max (a + b) = false) : checkedAddU64 a b = Result.ok (a + b) :=

def checkedCastU64ToUsize (v : Nat) : Result Nat :=
  match nat_blt usizeMax v with
  | true => Result.err Err.TooLarge
  | false => Result.ok v

def checkedCastU64ToUsize_success (v : Nat) (h : nat_blt usizeMax v = false) : checkedCastU64ToUsize v = Result.ok v :=
  @Eq.subst Bool (fun x => (match x with | true => Result.err Err.TooLarge | false => Result.ok v) = Result.ok v)
    false (nat_blt usizeMax v) (Eq.symm h) ⟨⟩

def checkedCastU64ToUsize_failure (v : Nat) (h : nat_blt usizeMax v = true) : checkedCastU64ToUsize v = Result.err Err.TooLarge :=
  @Eq.subst Bool (fun x => (match x with | true => Result.err Err.TooLarge | false => Result.ok v) = Result.err Err.TooLarge)
    true (nat_blt usizeMax v) (Eq.symm h) ⟨⟩

def listLength {α : Type} : List α → Nat
| [] => 0
| _ :: xs => Nat.succ (listLength xs)

def listNth {α : Type} : List α → Nat → Option α
| [], _ => Option.none
| x :: _, 0 => Option.some x
| _ :: xs, Nat.succ n => listNth xs n

def listUpdate {α : Type} : List α → Nat → α → List α
| [], _, _ => []
| _ :: xs, 0, v => v :: xs
| x :: xs, Nat.succ n, v => x :: listUpdate xs n v

def listTake {α : Type} : Nat → List α → List α
| 0, _ => []
| _, [] => []
| Nat.succ n, x :: xs => x :: listTake n xs

def listDrop {α : Type} : Nat → List α → List α
| 0, xs => xs
| _, [] => []
| Nat.succ n, _ :: xs => listDrop n xs

def rowSlice {α : Type} (L : List α) (row dim : Nat) : List α :=
  listTake dim (listDrop (row * dim) L)

def listMap {α β : Type} (f : α → β) : List α → List β
| [] => []
| x :: xs => f x :: listMap f xs

def listZipWith {α β γ : Type} (f : α → β → γ) : List α → List β → List γ
| [], _ => []
| _, [] => []
| x :: xs, y :: ys => f x y :: listZipWith f xs ys

structure Tensor (F : Type) where
  storageId : Nat
  storageOffset : Nat
  shape : List Nat
  data : List F

def tensorsOverlap {F : Type} (a b : Tensor F) : Bool :=
  match listLength a.data, listLength b.data with
  | 0, _ => false
  | _, 0 => false
  | Nat.succ _, Nat.succ _ =>
    match nat_eq a.storageId b.storageId with
    | false => false
    | true =>
      let a_end := a.storageOffset + listLength a.data
      let b_end := b.storageOffset + listLength b.data
      match nat_ble a_end b.storageOffset, nat_ble b_end a.storageOffset with
      | false, false => true
      | _, _ => false

def tensorsOverlap_empty_left {F : Type} (a b : Tensor F) (h : listLength a.data = 0) : tensorsOverlap a b = false :=
  @Eq.subst Nat (fun x => (match x, listLength b.data with | 0, _ => false | _, 0 => false | Nat.succ _, Nat.succ _ => match nat_eq a.storageId b.storageId with | false => false | true => match nat_ble (a.storageOffset + x) b.storageOffset, nat_ble (b.storageOffset + listLength b.data) a.storageOffset with | false, false => true | _, _ => false) = false)
    0 (listLength a.data) (Eq.symm h) ⟨⟩

def tensorsOverlap_empty_right {F : Type} (a b : Tensor F) (h : listLength b.data = 0) : tensorsOverlap a b = false :=
  match listLength a.data with
  | 0 => ⟨⟩
  | Nat.succ n =>
    @Eq.subst Nat (fun x => (match Nat.succ n, x with | 0, _ => false | _, 0 => false | Nat.succ _, Nat.succ _ => match nat_eq a.storageId b.storageId with | false => false | true => match nat_ble (a.storageOffset + Nat.succ n) b.storageOffset, nat_ble (b.storageOffset + x) a.storageOffset with | false, false => true | _, _ => false) = false)
      0 (listLength b.data) (Eq.symm h) ⟨⟩

def tensorClone {F : Type} (newId : Nat) (src : Tensor F) : Tensor F :=
  { storageId := newId,
    storageOffset := 0,
    shape := src.shape,
    data := src.data }

def tensorClone_freshId {F : Type} (newId : Nat) (src : Tensor F) : (tensorClone newId src).storageId = newId := ⟨⟩
def tensorClone_dataEq {F : Type} (newId : Nat) (src : Tensor F) : (tensorClone newId src).data = src.data := ⟨⟩
def tensorClone_shapeEq {F : Type} (newId : Nat) (src : Tensor F) : (tensorClone newId src).shape = src.shape := ⟨⟩

structure NumOps (F : Type) where
  add : F → F → F
  sub : F → F → F
  mul : F → F → F
  div : F → F → F
  exp : F → F
  clip : F → F → F → F
  isFinite : F → Bool
  tolOK : F → F → F → F → Bool
  inRange : F → F → F → Bool
  zero : F
  one : F
  toBits : F → U32
  fromBits : U32 → F

structure NumLaws (F : Type) (ops : NumOps F) where
  add_sub_cancel : ∀ a b, ops.sub (ops.add a b) b = a
  sub_add_cancel : ∀ a b, ops.add (ops.sub a b) b = a
  mul_div_cancel : ∀ a b, ops.div (ops.mul a b) b = a
  div_mul_cancel : ∀ a b, ops.mul (ops.div a b) b = a
  fromBits_toBits : ∀ x, ops.fromBits (ops.toBits x) = x
  add_zero : ∀ a, ops.add a ops.zero = a
  zero_add : ∀ a, ops.add ops.zero a = a
  mul_zero : ∀ a, ops.mul a ops.zero = ops.zero
  zero_mul : ∀ a, ops.mul ops.zero a = ops.zero

def ensureFiniteSlice {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : List F → Result Unit
| [] => Result.ok ()
| x :: xs =>
  match ops.isFinite x with
  | false => Result.err Err.NonFinite
  | true => ensureFiniteSlice ops xs

def validateClipRange {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (clip_min clip_max : F) : Result Unit :=
  match ops.isFinite clip_min, ops.isFinite clip_max with
  | true, true => Result.ok ()
  | _, _ => Result.err Err.NonFinite

def validateComparisonTolerances {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (abs_tol rel_tol : F) : Result Unit :=
  match ops.isFinite abs_tol, ops.isFinite rel_tol with
  | true, true => Result.ok ()
  | _, _ => Result.err Err.InvalidTolerance

def validateTensor2D {F : Type} (t : Tensor F) : Result Unit :=
  match t.shape with
  | [rows, cols] =>
    match checkedMul rows cols with
    | Result.ok expected =>
      match nat_eq (listLength t.data) expected with
      | true => Result.ok ()
      | false => Result.err Err.DataLengthMismatch
    | Result.err e => Result.err e
  | _ => Result.err Err.ShapeMismatch

def validateTensor2DShape {F : Type} (t : Tensor F) (rows cols : Nat) : Result Unit :=
  match t.shape with
  | [r, c] =>
    match nat_eq r rows, nat_eq c cols with
    | true, true =>
      match checkedMul rows cols with
      | Result.ok expected =>
        match nat_eq (listLength t.data) expected with
        | true => Result.ok ()
        | false => Result.err Err.DataLengthMismatch
      | Result.err e => Result.err e
    | _, _ => Result.err Err.ShapeMismatch
  | _ => Result.err Err.ShapeMismatch

structure RSFConfig (F : Type) where
  clip_min : F
  clip_max : F
  grad_mean : Bool
  max_dim : Nat
  max_layers : Nat

def validateModelConfigValues {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim num_layers : Nat) (cfg : RSFConfig F) : Result Unit :=
  match nat_eq dim 0, nat_eq num_layers 0 with
  | true, _ => Result.err Err.InvalidDimension
  | _, true => Result.err Err.InvalidLayerCount
  | false, false =>
    match validateClipRange ops cfg.clip_min cfg.clip_max with
    | Result.err e => Result.err e
    | Result.ok () =>
      match nat_eq cfg.max_dim 0, nat_eq cfg.max_layers 0 with
      | true, _ => Result.err Err.InvalidConfig
      | _, true => Result.err Err.InvalidConfig
      | false, false =>
        match nat_blt cfg.max_dim dim, nat_blt cfg.max_layers num_layers with
        | true, _ => Result.err Err.InvalidConfig
        | _, true => Result.err Err.InvalidConfig
        | false, false => Result.ok ()

def zeroList {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : Nat → List F
| 0 => []
| Nat.succ n => ops.zero :: zeroList ops n

def tensorZeroOut {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (t : Tensor F) : Tensor F :=
  { t with data := zeroList ops (listLength t.data) }

  t_weight_grad : Option (Tensor F)

def LayerCore.invariant {F : Type} (core : LayerCore F) : Prop := True

def dotProduct {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : List F → List F → F
| [], _ => ops.zero
| _, [] => ops.zero
| x :: xs, y :: ys => ops.add (ops.mul x y) (dotProduct ops xs ys)

def computeTranslationRow_rec {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) : Nat → List F → List F → List F → List F
| 0, _, _, _ => []
| Nat.succ d, t_weight_flat, t_bias, x1_row =>
  let w_row := listTake dim t_weight_flat
  let w_rest := listDrop dim t_weight_flat
  let b_val := match listNth t_bias 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let b_rest := listDrop 1 t_bias
  let sum := ops.add b_val (dotProduct ops w_row x1_row)
  sum :: computeTranslationRow_rec ops dim d w_rest b_rest x1_row

def computeTranslationRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (t_weight t_bias x1_row : List F) : List F :=
  computeTranslationRow_rec ops dim dim t_weight t_bias x1_row

def computeScaleRow_rec {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) : Nat → List F → List F → List F → List F
| 0, _, _, _ => []
| Nat.succ d, s_weight_flat, s_bias, x2_row =>
  let w_row := listTake dim s_weight_flat
  let w_rest := listDrop dim s_weight_flat
  let b_val := match listNth s_bias 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let b_rest := listDrop 1 s_bias
  let sum := ops.add b_val (dotProduct ops w_row x2_row)
  let clipped := ops.clip clip_min clip_max sum
  let scale := ops.exp clipped
  scale :: computeScaleRow_rec ops dim clip_min clip_max d w_rest b_rest x2_row

def computeScaleRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) (s_weight s_bias x2_row : List F) : List F :=
  computeScaleRow_rec ops dim clip_min clip_max dim s_weight s_bias x2_row

def forwardRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) (s_weight t_weight s_bias t_bias x1_row x2_row : List F) : List F × List F :=
  let scale := computeScaleRow ops dim clip_min clip_max s_weight s_bias x2_row
  let x1_scaled := listZipWith ops.mul x1_row scale
  let trans := computeTranslationRow ops dim t_weight t_bias x1_scaled
  let x2_trans := listZipWith ops.add x2_row trans
  (x1_scaled, x2_trans)

def inverseRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) (s_weight t_weight s_bias t_bias y1_row y2_row : List F) : List F × List F :=
  let trans := computeTranslationRow ops dim t_weight t_bias y1_row
  let y2_untrans := listZipWith ops.sub y2_row trans
  let scale := computeScaleRow ops dim clip_min clip_max s_weight s_bias y2_untrans
  let y1_unscaled := listZipWith ops.div y1_row scale
  (y1_unscaled, y2_untrans)

def listAdd {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : List F → List F → List F := listZipWith ops.add
def listSub {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : List F → List F → List F := listZipWith ops.sub
def listMul {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : List F → List F → List F := listZipWith ops.mul
def listDiv {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) : List F → List F → List F := listZipWith ops.div

def scaleList {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (s : F) (L : List F) : List F :=
  listMap (fun x => ops.mul s x) L

def accumulate_dy1_total_rec {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) : Nat → List F → List F → List F → List F
| 0, _, _, dy1_total => dy1_total
| Nat.succ d, t_weight_flat, dy2_row, dy1_total =>
  let w_row := listTake dim t_weight_flat
  let w_rest := listDrop dim t_weight_flat
  let dy2_val := match listNth dy2_row 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let dy2_rest := listDrop 1 dy2_row
  let scaled_w_row := scaleList ops dy2_val w_row
  let new_dy1_total := listAdd ops dy1_total scaled_w_row
  accumulate_dy1_total_rec ops dim d w_rest dy2_rest new_dy1_total

def accumulate_dy1_total {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (t_weight dy2_row dy1_row : List F) : List F :=
  accumulate_dy1_total_rec ops dim dim t_weight dy2_row dy1_row

def accumulate_t_weight_grad_rec {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (grad_scale : F) : Nat → List F → List F → List F → List F
| 0, _, _, t_weight_grad => t_weight_grad
| Nat.succ d, dy2_row, y1_row, t_weight_grad =>
  let dy2_val := match listNth dy2_row 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let dy2_rest := listDrop 1 dy2_row
  let dyv := ops.mul dy2_val grad_scale
  let scaled_y1_row := scaleList ops dyv y1_row
  let twg_row := listTake dim t_weight_grad
  let twg_rest := listDrop dim t_weight_grad
  let new_twg_row := listAdd ops twg_row scaled_y1_row
  new_twg_row ++ accumulate_t_weight_grad_rec ops dim grad_scale d dy2_rest y1_row twg_rest

def accumulate_t_bias_grad {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (grad_scale : F) (dy2_row t_bias_grad : List F) : List F :=
  listAdd ops t_bias_grad (scaleList ops grad_scale dy2_row)

def compute_ds_rec {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) : Nat → List F → List F → List F → List F → List F → List F
| 0, _, _, _, _, _ => []
| Nat.succ d, s_weight_flat, s_bias, x2_row, dy1_total, y1_row =>
  let w_row := listTake dim s_weight_flat
  let w_rest := listDrop dim s_weight_flat
  let b_val := match listNth s_bias 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let b_rest := listDrop 1 s_bias
  let pre_sum := ops.add b_val (dotProduct ops w_row x2_row)
  let dy1_val := match listNth dy1_total 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let y1_val := match listNth y1_row 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let ds_val := match ops.inRange pre_sum clip_min clip_max with
                | true => ops.mul dy1_val y1_val
                | false => ops.zero
  ds_val :: compute_ds_rec ops dim clip_min clip_max d w_rest b_rest x2_row (listDrop 1 dy1_total) (listDrop 1 y1_row)

def accumulate_s_weight_grad_rec {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (grad_scale : F) : Nat → List F → List F → List F → List F
| 0, _, _, s_weight_grad => s_weight_grad
| Nat.succ d, ds_row, x2_row, s_weight_grad =>
  let ds_val := match listNth ds_row 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let ds_rest := listDrop 1 ds_row
  let dsv := ops.mul ds_val grad_scale
  let scaled_x2_row := scaleList ops dsv x2_row
  let swg_row := listTake dim s_weight_grad
  let swg_rest := listDrop dim s_weight_grad
  let new_swg_row := listAdd ops swg_row scaled_x2_row
  new_swg_row ++ accumulate_s_weight_grad_rec ops dim grad_scale d ds_rest x2_row swg_rest

def accumulate_s_bias_grad {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (grad_scale : F) (ds_row s_bias_grad : List F) : List F :=
  listAdd ops s_bias_grad (scaleList ops grad_scale ds_row)

def accumulate_dx2_rec {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) : Nat → List F → List F → List F → List F
| 0, _, _, dx2 => dx2
| Nat.succ d, s_weight_flat, ds_row, dx2 =>
  let w_row := listTake dim s_weight_flat
  let w_rest := listDrop dim s_weight_flat
  let ds_val := match listNth ds_row 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let ds_rest := listDrop 1 ds_row
  let scaled_w_row := scaleList ops ds_val w_row
  let new_dx2 := listAdd ops dx2 scaled_w_row
  accumulate_dx2_rec ops dim d w_rest ds_rest new_dx2

def backwardFromOutputsRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max grad_scale : F)
  (s_weight t_weight s_bias t_bias y1_row y2_row dy1_row dy2_row s_weight_grad t_weight_grad s_bias_grad t_bias_grad : List F) :
  List F × List F × List F × List F × List F × List F × List F × List F :=
  let dy1_total := accumulate_dy1_total ops dim t_weight dy2_row dy1_row
  let new_t_weight_grad := accumulate_t_weight_grad_rec ops dim grad_scale dim dy2_row y1_row t_weight_grad
  let new_t_bias_grad := accumulate_t_bias_grad ops grad_scale dy2_row t_bias_grad
  let trans := computeTranslationRow ops dim t_weight t_bias y1_row
  let x2_row := listSub ops y2_row trans
  let ds := compute_ds_rec ops dim clip_min clip_max dim s_weight s_bias x2_row dy1_total y1_row
  let scale := computeScaleRow ops dim clip_min clip_max s_weight s_bias x2_row
  let x1_row := listDiv ops y1_row scale
  let dx1 := listMul ops dy1_total scale
  let new_s_weight_grad := accumulate_s_weight_grad_rec ops dim grad_scale dim ds x2_row s_weight_grad
  let new_s_bias_grad := accumulate_s_bias_grad ops grad_scale ds s_bias_grad
  let dx2 := accumulate_dx2_rec ops dim dim s_weight ds dy2_row
  (x1_row, x2_row, dx1, dx2, new_s_weight_grad, new_t_weight_grad, new_s_bias_grad, new_t_bias_grad)

structure RegistryEntry (α : Type) where
  id : Nat
  activeOps : Nat
  destroyed : Bool
  payload : α

structure Registry (α : Type) where
  entries : List (RegistryEntry α)
  nextId : Nat

def AllIdsNonZero {α : Type} : List (RegistryEntry α) → Prop
| [] => True
| e :: es => e.id > 0 ∧ AllIdsNonZero es

def IdNotPresent {α : Type} (id : Nat) : List (RegistryEntry α) → Prop
| [] => True
| e :: es => ¬(e.id = id) ∧ IdNotPresent id es

def AllIdsUnique {α : Type} : List (RegistryEntry α) → Prop
| [] => True
| e :: es => IdNotPresent e.id es ∧ AllIdsUnique es

def NextIdValid {α : Type} (nextId : Nat) : List (RegistryEntry α) → Prop
| [] => True
| e :: es => nextId > e.id ∧ NextIdValid nextId es

structure ValidRegistry (α : Type) where
  reg : Registry α
  h_next_pos : reg.nextId > 0
  h_nonzero : AllIdsNonZero reg.entries
  h_unique : AllIdsUnique reg.entries
  h_next : NextIdValid reg.nextId reg.entries

def nat_succ_pos (n : Nat) : Nat.succ n > 0 := Nat.zero_lt_succ n
def nat_succ_gt {n m : Nat} (h : n > m) : Nat.succ n > m := Nat.lt_trans h (Nat.lt_succ_self n)

def nextIdValid_succ {α : Type} {nextId : Nat} {es : List (RegistryEntry α)} (h : NextIdValid nextId es) : NextIdValid (Nat.succ nextId) es :=
  match es, h with
  | [], _ => ⟨⟩
  | e :: rest, ⟨h_gt, h_rest⟩ => ⟨nat_succ_gt h_gt, nextIdValid_succ h_rest⟩

def idNotPresent_of_gt {α : Type} {id : Nat} {es : List (RegistryEntry α)} (h : NextIdValid id es) : IdNotPresent id es :=
  match es, h with
  | [], _ => ⟨⟩
  | e :: rest, ⟨h_gt, h_rest⟩ =>
    let h_neq : ¬(e.id = id) := fun heq => Nat.lt_irrefl id (@Eq.subst Nat (fun x => x < id) e.id id heq h_gt)
    ⟨h_neq, idNotPresent_of_gt h_rest⟩

def registerRegistryCore {α : Type} (r : ValidRegistry α) (payload : α) : ValidRegistry α × Nat :=
  let newEntry := { id := r.reg.nextId, activeOps := 0, destroyed := false, payload := payload : RegistryEntry α }
  let newReg := { entries := newEntry :: r.reg.entries, nextId := Nat.succ r.reg.nextId : Registry α }
  let h_next_pos' : newReg.nextId > 0 := nat_succ_pos r.reg.nextId
  let h_nonzero' : AllIdsNonZero newReg.entries := ⟨r.h_next_pos, r.h_nonzero⟩
  let h_unique' : AllIdsUnique newReg.entries := ⟨idNotPresent_of_gt r.h_next, r.h_unique⟩
  let h_next' : NextIdValid newReg.nextId newReg.entries := ⟨Nat.lt_succ_self r.reg.nextId, nextIdValid_succ r.h_next⟩
  ({ reg := newReg, h_next_pos := h_next_pos', h_nonzero := h_nonzero', h_unique := h_unique', h_next := h_next' }, r.reg.nextId)

def crcUpdateBit (c : Nat) : Nat :=
  match c % 2 with
  | 1 => Nat.xor (c / 2) 0xEDB88320
  | _ => c / 2

def crcUpdateByte_loop : Nat → Nat → Nat
| 0, c => c
| Nat.succ i, c =>
  match c % 2 with
  | 1 => crcUpdateByte_loop i (Nat.xor (c / 2) 0xEDB88320)
  | _ => crcUpdateByte_loop i (c / 2)

def crcUpdateByte (c : Nat) (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  crcUpdateByte_loop 8 (Nat.xor c b)

| [] => c

def crcUpdateList_foldl (c : Nat) (bs : List Nat) : crcUpdateList c bs = List.foldl crcUpdateByte c bs :=

  | [] => ⟨⟩
  | b :: rest => crcUpdateList_foldl (crcUpdateByte c b) rest

def checkedMul (a b : Nat) : Result Nat :=

def checkedMul_success (a b : Nat) (h : nat_blt usizeMax (a * b) = false) : checkedMul a b = Result.ok (a * b) :=
  @Eq.subst Bool (fun x => (match x with | true => Result.err Err.Overflow | false => Result.ok (a * b)) = Result.ok (a * b))
    false (nat_blt usizeMax (a * b)) (Eq.symm h) ⟨⟩

  @Eq.subst Bool (fun x => (match x with | true => Result.err Err.Overflow | false => Result.ok (a * b)) = Result.err Err.Overflow)
    true (nat_blt usizeMax (a * b)) (Eq.symm h) ⟨⟩

def tensorsOverlap {F : Type} (a b : Tensor F) : Bool :=
  match listLength a.data, listLength b.data with
  | 0, _ => false
  | _, 0 => false
  | Nat.succ _, Nat.succ _ =>
    match nat_eq a.storageId b.storageId with
    | false => false
    | true =>
      let a_end := a.storageOffset + listLength a.data
      let b_end := b.storageOffset + listLength b.data
      match nat_ble a_end b.storageOffset, nat_ble b_end a.storageOffset with
      | false, false => true
      | _, _ => false

def tensorsOverlap_empty_left {F : Type} (a b : Tensor F) (h : listLength a.data = 0) : tensorsOverlap a b = false :=
  @Eq.subst Nat (fun x => (match x, listLength b.data with | 0, _ => false | _, 0 => false | Nat.succ _, Nat.succ _ => match nat_eq a.storageId b.storageId with | false => false | true => match nat_ble (a.storageOffset + x) b.storageOffset, nat_ble (b.storageOffset + listLength b.data) a.storageOffset with | false, false => true | _, _ => false) = false)
    0 (listLength a.data) (Eq.symm h) ⟨⟩

def tensorsOverlap_empty_right {F : Type} (a b : Tensor F) (h : listLength b.data = 0) : tensorsOverlap a b = false :=
  match listLength a.data with
  | 0 => ⟨⟩
  | Nat.succ n =>
    @Eq.subst Nat (fun x => (match Nat.succ n, x with | 0, _ => false | _, 0 => false | Nat.succ _, Nat.succ _ => match nat_eq a.storageId b.storageId with | false => false | true => match nat_ble (a.storageOffset + Nat.succ n) b.storageOffset, nat_ble (b.storageOffset + x) a.storageOffset with | false, false => true | _, _ => false) = false)
      0 (listLength b.data) (Eq.symm h) ⟨⟩

def computeTranslationRow_rec {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) : Nat → List F → List F → List F → List F
| 0, _, _, _ => []
| Nat.succ d, t_weight_flat, t_bias, x1_row =>
  let w_row := listTake dim t_weight_flat
  let w_rest := listDrop dim t_weight_flat
  let b_val := match listNth t_bias 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let b_rest := listDrop 1 t_bias
  let sum := ops.add b_val (dotProduct ops w_row x1_row)
  sum :: computeTranslationRow_rec ops dim d w_rest b_rest x1_row

def computeScaleRow_rec {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) : Nat → List F → List F → List F → List F
| 0, _, _, _ => []
| Nat.succ d, s_weight_flat, s_bias, x2_row =>
  let w_row := listTake dim s_weight_flat
  let w_rest := listDrop dim s_weight_flat
  let b_val := match listNth s_bias 0 with | Option.some v => v | Option.none => ops.zero
  let b_rest := listDrop 1 s_bias
  let sum := ops.add b_val (dotProduct ops w_row x2_row)
  let clipped := ops.clip clip_min clip_max sum
  let scale := ops.exp clipped
  scale :: computeScaleRow_rec ops dim clip_min clip_max d w_rest b_rest x2_row

def computeScaleRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) (s_weight s_bias x2_row : List F) : List F :=
  computeScaleRow_rec ops dim clip_min clip_max dim s_weight s_bias x2_row

def forwardRow {F : Type} (ops : NumOps F) (dim : Nat) (clip_min clip_max : F) (s_weight t_weight s_bias t_bias x1_row x2_row : List F) : List F × List F :=
  let scale := computeScaleRow ops dim clip_min clip_max s_weight s_bias x2_row

structure RegistryEntry (α : Type) where
  id : Nat
  activeOps : Nat
  destroyed : Bool
  payload : α

structure Registry (α : Type) where
  entries : List (RegistryEntry α)
  nextId : Nat

def AllIdsNonZero {α : Type} : List (RegistryEntry α) → Prop
| [] => True
| e :: es => e.id > 0 ∧ AllIdsNonZero es

def IdNotPresent {α : Type} (id : Nat) : List (RegistryEntry α) → Prop
| [] => True
| e :: es => ¬(e.id = id) ∧ IdNotPresent id es

def AllIdsUnique {α : Type} : List (RegistryEntry α) → Prop
| [] => True
| e :: es => IdNotPresent e.id es ∧ AllIdsUnique es

def NextIdValid {α : Type} (nextId : Nat) : List (RegistryEntry α) → Prop
| [] => True
| e :: es => nextId > e.id ∧ NextIdValid nextId es

structure ValidRegistry (α : Type) where
  reg : Registry α
  h_next_pos : reg.nextId > 0
  h_nonzero : AllIdsNonZero reg.entries
  h_unique : AllIdsUnique reg.entries
  h_next : NextIdValid reg.nextId reg.entries

def nat_succ_pos (n : Nat) : Nat.succ n > 0 := Nat.zero_lt_succ n
def nat_succ_gt {n m : Nat} (h : n > m) : Nat.succ n > m := Nat.lt_trans h (Nat.lt_succ_self n)

def nextIdValid_succ {α : Type} {nextId : Nat} {es : List (RegistryEntry α)} (h : NextIdValid nextId es) : NextIdValid (Nat.succ nextId) es :=
  match es, h with
  | [], _ => ⟨⟩
  | e :: rest, ⟨h_gt, h_rest⟩ => ⟨nat_succ_gt h_gt, nextIdValid_succ h_rest⟩

def idNotPresent_of_gt {α : Type} {id : Nat} {es : List (RegistryEntry α)} (h : NextIdValid id es) : IdNotPresent id es :=
  match es, h with
  | [], _ => ⟨⟩
  | e :: rest, ⟨h_gt, h_rest⟩ =>
    let h_neq : ¬(e.id = id) := fun heq => Nat.lt_irrefl id (@Eq.subst Nat (fun x => x < id) e.id id heq h_gt)
    ⟨h_neq, idNotPresent_of_gt h_rest⟩

def registerRegistryCore {α : Type} (r : ValidRegistry α) (payload : α) : ValidRegistry α × Nat :=
  let newEntry := { id := r.reg.nextId, activeOps := 0, destroyed := false, payload := payload : RegistryEntry α }
  let newReg := { entries := newEntry :: r.reg.entries, nextId := Nat.succ r.reg.nextId : Registry α }
  let h_next_pos' : newReg.nextId > 0 := nat_succ_pos r.reg.nextId
  let h_nonzero' : AllIdsNonZero newReg.entries := ⟨r.h_next_pos, r.h_nonzero⟩
  let h_unique' : AllIdsUnique newReg.entries := ⟨idNotPresent_of_gt r.h_next, r.h_unique⟩
  let h_next' : NextIdValid newReg.nextId newReg.entries := ⟨Nat.lt_succ_self r.reg.nextId, nextIdValid_succ r.h_next⟩
  ({ reg := newReg, h_next_pos := h_next_pos', h_nonzero := h_nonzero', h_unique := h_unique', h_next := h_next' }, r.reg.nextId)

def maybeShrinkRegistry {α : Type} (r : Registry α) : Registry α :=

def crcUpdateBit (c : Nat) : Nat :=
  match c % 2 with
  | 1 => Nat.xor (c / 2) 0xEDB88320
  | _ => c / 2

def crcUpdateByte_loop : Nat → Nat → Nat
| 0, c => c
| Nat.succ i, c =>

  | b :: rest => crcUpdateList_foldl (crcUpdateByte c b) rest

  match layers with

      | false => false

        | Option.some _ => true
